_how: Each city's point is its entry in city-centroids.js (a station). The area is the JMA warning area (気象警報・注意報（市町村等）) that contains that point, found by point-in-polygon against JMA's own GIS file 20260226_AreaInformationCity_weather_GIS.zip (市町村等（気象警報等）, https://www.data.jma.go.jp/developer/gis.html), read 01-11 '26. Every point fell in exactly one polygon. The office is the area's chain class20 -> class15 -> class10 -> office in https://www.jma.go.jp/bosai/common/const/area.json, read the same day. Five cities are split by JMA, and the point decides which part: Yokohama (south), Sendai (east), Nara (west), Kobe (Chuo-ku) and Hiroshima (Minami-ku).
